figures.caption: General structure of the cyclolipopeptide analogs (upper left, analog 1, see Table 1). The structural and chemical features discussed for the design of the analogs are highlighted. Natural polymyxin B is shown below. The structure of lanreotide (right), a commercially available disulfide cyclic peptide having two D-amino acids is shown for comparison. Lanreotide is used for the treatment of acromegaly and neuroendocrine tumours and some 100-200 Kg are produced every year worldwide.
figures.label: Figure 1
